mapper.select: select a.SETTLE_NO as settleNo,a.ZB_CONTRACT_NO as contractNo,a.ZB_CONTRACT_AMOUNT as contractAmount, a.ZB_CONTRACT_NAME as contractName,a.STATUS as status,b.* from BIZ_PRJ_SETTLE a left join BIZ_PRJ_SETTLE_INVOICE b on a.ID = b.SETTLE_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ${ew.customSqlSegment}
